title: Early Cell Division
text: After fertilization, the zygote divides by mitosis: 2 cells, 4 cells, 8 cells, etc. By day 3, it forms a solid ball called a morula (from Latin 'mulberry').

title: Formation of Cavity
text: By day 5, a fluid-filled cavity forms in the center, creating a hollow structure. 'Blast' means bud or germ, and 'cyst' means cavity. The structure is called a blastocyst.
